proposal.reason: Main change is P2P transport memory-FD exchange behavior: add opt-in pidfd fallback for GetFd/QueryFd and registration flows in src/transport/p2p.cc. Also includes independently substantive proxy protocol/lifecycle changes in src/proxy.cc (new CloseFd message, async response queue ordering, connection FD ownership/cleanup, and service-failure shutdown behavior), which falls under network proxy progress/connection-resource ownership.
